appraisal_events.evidence: Un de ces passages de Bergotte... me donna une joie incomparable... je pleurai sur les pages de l'écrivain comme dans les bras d'un père retrouvé.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator recounts a deepening, near-devotional admiration for Bergotte's style and thought, elevating him into a supreme literary and philosophical authority.

appraisal_events.evidence: il me sembla soudain que mon humble vie et les royaumes du vrai n'étaient pas aussi séparés que j'avais cru... mon cœur se gonflait comme si un Dieu dans sa bonté me l'avait rendue, l'avait déclarée légitime et belle.
appraisal_events.explanation: Discovering that his own private remarks and thoughts are echoed in Bergotte's revered work legitimizes and elevates the narrator's own perceptions by association with the admired writer.

status_effects.explanation: Bergotte is locally elevated to the status of an all-but-worshipped authority through the narrator's escalating admiration.
The narrator gains a sense of legitimacy and joyful confidence upon finding his own private thoughts validated by resemblance to Bergotte's celebrated work.
